label: Стул
description: Full case ladder of стул (chair), including its irregular -ья plural, with everyday collocations and prepositional scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Стул' is the nominative singular, naming the chair. 2. 'Это' is a pointing word, not a verb. 3. A bare equational sentence with no copula in the present tense.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 1. 'Стул' is the accusative singular, identical to nominative for inanimate masculines. 2. 'Новый' agrees in case and number. 3. 'Купил' is a perfective past verb.

Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 1. 'На стул' shows motion onto a surface, so 'стул' is accusative. 2. 'Сел' is a perfective motion-result verb. 3. The preposition 'на' takes accusative for destination.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 1. 'Стула' is the genitive singular, marking the chair as owner. 2. 'Ножка' is the possessed part. 3. Genitive links two nouns to mean 'the leg of the chair'.

Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 1. 'Со стула' marks motion away from a surface, so 'стула' is genitive. 2. 'Со' is the spelled-out form of 'с' before a consonant cluster. 3. 'Встал' is a perfective rising verb.

Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 1. 'Нет' forces genitive on what is missing, so 'стула' is genitive. 2. 'Свободного' agrees in the genitive. 3. Negated existence always governs the genitive case.
Strategic focus: Dative of goal. 1. 'К стулу' marks approach toward an object, so 'стулу' is dative. 2. 'К' always governs the dative. 3. 'Подошёл' is a perfective verb of approach.
Strategic focus: Dative direction. 1. 'Стулу' is dative singular, the target of movement. 2. 'К' governs the dative to mean 'toward'. 3. 'Идти' is an imperfective verb of motion on foot.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of position. 1. 'Над стулом' places the action above the chair, so 'стулом' is instrumental. 2. 'Над' governs the instrumental. 3. 'Наклонился' is a reflexive perfective verb.

Strategic focus: Instrumental of location. 1. 'Под стулом' marks static position beneath, so 'стулом' is instrumental. 2. 'Под' takes instrumental when no motion is implied. 3. 'Лежит' shows the cat resting there.

Strategic focus: Prepositional of place. 1. 'На стуле' marks static location, so 'стуле' is prepositional. 2. 'На' takes the prepositional for position, not motion. 3. 'Сидеть' is an imperfective stative verb.

Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 1. 'На стуле' tells where the book rests, so 'стуле' is prepositional. 2. 'На' with prepositional means resting position. 3. 'Лежит' is an imperfective stative verb.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Деревянный' is nominative masculine singular, matching 'стул'. 2. The adjective shares the case, gender, and number of its noun. 3. The phrase names the material of the chair.

Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Удобный' agrees with 'стул' in nominative masculine singular. 2. The hard '-ый' ending mirrors the masculine noun. 3. The phrase describes a comfortable chair.

Strategic focus: Irregular nominative plural. 1. 'Стулья' is the irregular -ья plural, not the expected стулы. 2. 'Новые' agrees in the nominative plural. 3. This soft-stem plural is a high-frequency exception worth memorizing.

Strategic focus: Irregular genitive plural. 1. 'Стульев' is the irregular genitive plural with -ьев, from the -ья stem. 2. Numbers above four govern the genitive plural. 3. The chair's odd plural carries through every plural case.

missions.phrase: Гости сидят на стульях у стены.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. 1. 'На стульях' marks where they sit, so 'стульях' is the prepositional plural. 2. The irregular -ья stem keeps the soft ending here too. 3. 'Сидят' is third-person plural imperfective.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. 1. 'Между стульями' marks position among the chairs, so 'стульями' is the instrumental plural. 2. 'Между' governs the instrumental. 3. The soft -ья stem yields the -ьями ending.
